title: Woman with Squirrels on Mount Wilson, California, c. 1945
description: A vintage black and white photograph of a young woman posing next to a large concrete tree planter on Mount Wilson, California. She is wearing a light-colored dress and holding a black-and-white checkered clutch. On the rim of the planter, two squirrels are visible. A sign posted on the tree trunk reads, 'ON ACCOUNT OF THE LARGE NUMBER OF DEER ON MOUNT WILSON DOGS ARE NOT ALLOWED,' providing a clear geographical and historical context for this tourist snapshot.
